examples.en: The incident cast doubt on her motives and reliability.
examples.zh: 这件事使人怀疑她有何动机，以及她是否可靠。

examples.en: Car buyers are more interested in safety and reliability than speed.
examples.zh: 比起速度，汽车买主更关注安全性和可靠性。

examples.en: Our goods compete in terms of product quality, reliability and above all variety.
examples.zh: 我们的产品从质量、可靠性、尤其是多样性来看很有竞争力。
